name: valley-primal-v1
purpose: Certify Lemma M on the primal valley region V: for every (r, w, phi) with r in [0, 3/10], w in [9/20, 19/10], phi in [0, 31416/5000] (covers [0, 2 pi] >= theta1(r)), at least one of: SGE (a1 > 0 and G = 2 a0 a2 - (1+T) a1^2 > 0, i.e. S > T), DPOS (a0, a1, a2 > 0 and D > 0, i.e. dS/dr > 0 at fixed w, phi), INFEAS (phi_lo > pi and g_{r_lo}(phi_lo) > 1, i.e. every point has phi > theta1(r)).
split_rule: bisect the dimension with the largest width (r, w, phi widths compared directly), at the exact rational midpoint
arithmetic: python-flint 0.9.0 arb/acb ball arithmetic, ctx.prec = 128 bits; a box [lo, hi] enters as arb(lo).union(arb(hi)) with lo, hi exact rationals (fmpq)
fail_rule: a box reaching max_depth without an outcome is recorded as FAIL; any FAIL means the certificate failed (no conclusion)
outputs: valley.json (counts per outcome, depth histogram, FAIL list, bounding box of DPOS boxes, sha256 of the ordered leaf list), dpos_leaves.txt (exact rational endpoints of every DPOS leaf)
